tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch3:3-18Let $\Gamma \subset E(2)$ be the subgroup defined by (3.20). Prove that $\Gamma $ acts freely and properly on $\mathbb {R}^2$ and the orbit space is homeomorphic to the Klein bottle, and conclude that the Klein bottle has a flat metric and a Riemannian covering by the Euclidean plane. \end{exercise}
